text.aria-label: Title text 'Figure 12: The best point-forecast round 2 arm has a lower error than production at every lead day, for all four series types'
text.tspan: Figure 12: The best point-forecast round 2 arm has a lower error than
production at every lead day, for all four series types

text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Mean absolute error of the ensemble mean (the average of the 51 ensemble members) as a percentage of effective capacity; smaller is better, zero is a perfect forecast. Each point averages every half-hourly forecast of the type's series, over all 53 weekly runs of the validation year (July 2025 to June 2026). Day 1 is the first 24 hours after a run's initialisation time. Leads of 11 days and more are left out. The best point-forecast round 2 arm combines the absolute-error loss, early stopping, the forecast lead-time column, lean wind columns, and one model per series type with a site identifier; it was chosen after seeing round 1 (post hoc).'
text.tspan: Mean absolute error of the ensemble mean (the average of the 51 ensemble members) as a percentage of effective
capacity; smaller is better, zero is a perfect forecast. Each point averages every half-hourly forecast of the
type's series, over all 53 weekly runs of the validation year (July 2025 to June 2026).
Day 1 is the first 24 hours after a run's initialisation time. Leads of 11 days and more are left out. The best
point-forecast round 2 arm combines the absolute-error loss, early stopping, the forecast lead-time column, lean
wind columns, and one model per series type with a site identifier; it was chosen after seeing round 1 (post hoc).
